findings.summary: Modern per-hash miss ignores legacy fallback, while a newer failed-save fallback can also lose to stale IndexedDB data.
evidence: extension/content/cm-gtc-client.js: queryGlobalTranslationCache returns response.entriesByHash immediately on any successful GTC_QUERY_MANY response.
The raw gtc_<hash> fallback is consulted only when the whole modern request is not ok.
saveGlobalTranslationCacheEntry writes raw gtc_<hash> after a failed GTC_SAVE and removes it after a later successful GTC_SAVE.
tests/integration/ipc/gtc-indexeddb-deep.test.js explicitly requires zero legacy lookup for a complete modern hit; this must be preserved.
required_cases: newest explicitly-marked failed-save fallback -> beats stale IndexedDB hit
unmarked historical legacy + valid modern hit -> modern hit wins
findings.safe_fix_direction: Use an explicit companion marker/version for recent failed-save fallback. Overlay marked fallback over stale modern hits, fill modern misses from raw legacy, but never let unmarked historical legacy overwrite a valid modern hit.
findings.reason_correction_not_authorized: Protected handoff requires a distinct ADVERSARIAL decision for the same source_sha+bible_sha.
